approved_scope.title: Fix 329
acceptance_criteria: chough bug add while a session is active puts the new bug on that session's bugs list, with or without --observation, so a blocking bug filed with nothing linked stops that session leaving test and its story names it. A bug added with no session active is on no session's bugs list and stops no session, and chough next names it as not blocking that session. chough bug update with --observation joins the active session only when the entry it names is that session's, as before.

No other lesson or principle constrains it.
